==Notes==
* Splinter Weapon can deal an enormous amount of damage when combined with Triple Chop or Cyclone Axe, especially in Hard Mode, where they have 20 channeling magic. That skill alone can increase the pressure these warriors deal by an order of magnitude, hitting for upwards of 400 damage in a cluster every few second, on top of their usual melee attacks. Since it's the only spell they use, it can be disabled for the duration of the fight with skills like [[Smooth Criminal]] to substantially reduce their output. Heroes don't use the similar skills [[Arcane Larceny]] and [[Arcane Thievery]] very well on their own, but can be controlled manually to disable it.
